_doc: Clan heirlooms (rules-proposals R7). Unpriced proposals; sizes follow the catalogues' grade 2-3 items.

items.name: Old Locust Seal (Lão Hòe Ấn)

effects.name: Under the Locust (Hòe Hạ)
effects.rule: For the first 10 s of a fight, Water and Wood wards you cast are 20 % thicker.

items.lore: Cut from the stump of the first locust Tiêu Chủng Hòe planted on the road in 520, which died in the frost of 1010, the winter Tiêu Kiến Quang died. The seal face is the tree's rings; the clan's land deeds are stamped with it.
items.build_use: Wards and regeneration for a head who wins by waiting.

items.name: Keystone Toll Seal (Thu Kiều Ấn)

effects.name: The Toll (Lộ Phí)
effects.rule: Each time a foe's hit is blocked, you take 1 % of that foe's current linh lực.

items.lore: Cut from the keystone left over when Ôn Giá Hồng closed the north bridge's arch in 900. Every toll token of Song Kiều is stamped with it, and the Pivot's assayers have never liked the sight.
items.build_use: Block, defence and a drain for a body cultivator who stands in the way.

items.name: Swallow Hall Fan (Yến Đường Phiến)

effects.name: The Swallow Returns (Yến Quy)
effects.rule: Your first art of each fight is cast again 3 s later at 40 % power.

items.lore: One of the two things Tạ Bất Vong carried out of the old hall in 470. The ribs are black bamboo; the leaf is painted with swallows over a hall no one in Phong Lâm has seen.
items.build_use: Wood art speed with a free echo of the opening art.

items.name: Returning Ink Pendant (Quy Mặc Bội)
items.lore: A black jade the size of an ink cake, cut with the old hall's name in a script no Tạ can now read. The second thing carried out in 470.
items.build_use: Soul ward and linh lực for a scholar.

items.name: First Sheaf Bell (Đầu Hòa Chung)

effects.name: The Harvest Bell (Thu Hoạch Chung)
effects.rule: Once a fight, when you fall below half health, the bell rings: you and your allies heal 8 % of maximum health over 4 s.

items.lore: Rung at Phong Đăng each autumn when the first sheaf is cut, to tell the Tower's counters the Lục are ready to be taxed first (A288). Cast in 601 from the copper of the first year's tax receipts.
items.build_use: Sustain and a party heal for a farmer who fights rarely.

items.name: Misty Wave Mirror (Yên Ba Kính)

effects.name: Reading the Weather (Khán Thiên)
effects.rule: Once every 12 s you see a foe's next art 1 s before it is cast.

items.lore: A ship's mirror for reading haze off the cape, bought by Hỗ Độ Hải from a Thúy Vi refiner in 1041 with the Thẩm dowry. Hỗ Tế Xuyên uses it for reading faces across a table.
items.build_use: Evasion and foresight for a fighter who leaves.

items.name: Golden Reeling Needle (Kim Trừu Châm)

effects.name: The Drawn Thread (Trừu Ti)
effects.rule: Each hit of a Fire art draws a thread: the foe's evade falls 2 % per thread, and each thread lasts 8 s on its own.

items.lore: The reeling needle Nhan Dư Ti carried out of Hỏa Ti in 590, gilded by her grandson. The head of the Đới wears it in her hair and has never let the palace's factor see it closely.
items.build_use: Fire debuffs that pin a fast foe.

items.name: Granary Seal of Phong Đăng (Phong Đăng Thương Ấn)
items.lore: The seal the Lục press on every granary door after the harvest; the Tower's tax men must break it to count.
items.build_use: Health and regrowth: the man who outlasts a drought.

items.name: Seed-Store Gourd (Tàng Chủng Hồ)
items.lore: A gourd of seed rice from every harvest since 600, kept by the Seed Store Method; it is never emptied, only topped up.
items.build_use: Linh lực and lasting Wood buffs.

items.name: Lost Captain's Ring (Thất Thuyền Chủ Giới)
items.lore: Hỗ Độ Hải's captain's ring, left ashore by mistake the morning he sailed off the cape in 1120 with three ships and did not come back.
items.build_use: A merchant's ring: linh lực and evasion to leave.

items.name: White Sands Robe (Bạch Sa Bào)
items.lore: Pale sailcloth from his mother's town of Bạch Sa, made into a robe when she died; it is the colour of the beach.
items.build_use: Health and evasion for the merchant who leaves.

items.name: Mulberry Thimble (Tang Điền Đỉnh)
items.lore: A reeler's thimble of fire-hardened mulberry wood, worn smooth by the house's heads since Nhan Dư Ti.
items.build_use: Burn that lasts: the thread drawn out fine.

items.name: Father's Rope Knot (Phụ Thằng Kết)
items.lore: A knot from the end of Tiêu Kiến Quang's search rope, set in green jade on the day of his burial in 1010.
items.build_use: Wards that hold while he waits.

items.name: Locust-Dye Robe (Hòe Nhiễm Bào)
items.lore: Dyed yellow in the Tiêu's own locust-flower vats; the dye works have made only one robe of this cloth a century.
items.build_use: Health and regrowth for an old man who outlasts.

items.name: East Pillar Shield (Đông Trụ Thuẫn)
items.lore: A face of the eastern bridge pillar his father held in the flood of 1112, cut away when the pillar was rebuilt.

items.name: Flood-Year Coat (Hồng Niên Giáp)
items.lore: A toll-keeper's coat of river-silt felt, stiff as clay; he wore it the night the flood took his father and has not worn another.
items.build_use: Health and a body shield: the man is a pillar.

items.name: Hall Seal of the Tạ (Tạ Đường Ấn)
items.lore: The seal on every letter the Tạ have sent since Tạ Bất Vong cut it at Phong Lâm; its characters still name the old hall.
items.build_use: The scholar's brush: Wood art speed and thần thức.

sets.name: The Old Hall (Cựu Đường Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Swallow Returns to Its Nest (Yến Hoàn Cựu Sào): every third Wood art you cast is copied once, for free, as a soul-ink art against the same foe.

sets.story: The three things the Tạ carried out of their old hall in 470: the fan, the ink jade and the hall's seal. The head holds the fan and the seal, his elder son the jade; the set is whole only in one pair of hands, which by custom means the next head. Tạ Cựu Đường has not given his son the fan, and his son has not asked.

sets.name: The Granary (Thương Lẫm Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Outlast the Drought (Nại Hạn): every 10 s of a fight you store a seed; when you would fall below a fifth of your health, all stored seeds are eaten at once and each heals 8 % of your health.

sets.story: The bell rung at the first sheaf, the granary seal and the seed gourd: the Lục harvest, which the Tower counts before anyone else's.

sets.name: The Hỗ Fleet (Hỗ Gia Thuyền Đội)

bonuses.effect: Leave With the Tide (Tùy Triều Khứ): once a fight, when you fall below half health, you step away: you take no damage for 2 s, regain 10 % of your linh lực, and your next art is a sure hit.

sets.story: His father's ring, his mother's sailcloth and the mirror the house reads the weather in: the marriage that made the white sands a trading town, worn by its son.

sets.name: Reeling Thread (Trừu Ti Song Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Pulled Tight (Khẩn Thu): when a foe carries 6 or more of your Burn stacks, your next needle art pulls them tight and all of its Burn deals its remaining damage at once.

sets.story: The house's needle and the thimble of its first head: they pass together to the best reeler, never to the eldest child.

sets.name: Locust Shade (Hòe Âm Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: He Waited (Đẳng Đãi): for each 10 s you are Still, your wards gain 5 % strength, and the gain falls away by a fifth each second once you move; your first damaging art after it is a sure hit.

sets.story: The locust seal of the clan, the knot from his father's rope and the dye works' robe: everything the Tiêu kept while they waited eighty years for the cave.

sets.name: Twin Bridges (Song Kiều Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Pillar in the Flood (Lưu Trung Trụ): while above half health you cannot be moved, and every fifth hit you block takes a toll: the attacker loses 3 % of its linh lực and you gain it.

sets.story: The toll seal his father cut in 900, the pillar face and the flood coat: the Ôn bridges as one man wears them.
